text:
Priya (Support): FYI - customer reported big p99 spike after enabling tool/function-calling with strict JSON schema validation. They see normal p50/p95 but p99 up ~3-4x, only after enabling structured output. Ticket: INC-5789.
Sam (Eng-runtime): ACK. Which model variant + router config? Any request examples?
Priya (Support): Sending sample request & headers we got from customer (redacted):

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b", "tool_call":{"name":"lookup_user","schema":{...}}, "max_tokens":128}'

Priya (Support): Router header: X-Redwood-Route: tool-router-v2; concurrency=32; they enabled strict_schema=true in their route config last night.
Evan (Eng-platform): I pulled router traces for that tenant id. Validator service latency is usually 6-12ms, but we're seeing a tail at 90-120ms during bursts. Combined with our batching queue this pushes the overall p99 up.
Sam (Eng-runtime): Is validator synchronous on the request path? I thought we offload to async worker if schema > threshold.
Evan (Eng-platform): It used to be async for large schemas but strict_schema toggle forces sync validation in the router to guarantee response before tool invocation. That avoids invalid tool calls but adds blocking time. At low QPS it's fine; at high QPS it creates head-of-line blocking and queue buildup.
Matt (Oncall): Immediate mitigation options? Customer wants quick fix.
Sam (Eng-runtime): Short-term: flip strict_schema=false for that customer's route so validator runs off-path. We can also route them to the no-validator model-variant (toolcall-fast) we keep for high-throughput customers.
Priya (Support): Customer approved temporary change for the next 30m while you investigate. Do you want me to do the config flip or should eng push a canary rollback?
Sam (Eng-runtime): Priya please flip strict_schema=false on their route (we have permission for emergency config changes). I'll watch metrics.
InfraBot: Deploy bot: route-config update initiated by Priya (Support) for tenant acme-co: set strict_schema=false -> canary on 2 pods.
Sam (Eng-runtime): After flip — watch p99 in /router/latency and validator queue length. Also bump per-router worker threads + increase validator pool by 2 nodes if queue > 10.
Evan (Eng-platform): Long-term fixes we discussed: 1) Make schema validator non-blocking by returning preliminary tool args and validating in a light-mode (basic shape) on-path, full schema check off-path. 2) Add a fast-path that skips schema checks for small/simple schemas (heuristic). 3) Add explicit telemetry for schema validation time per-request and alert if validator p99 > 30ms.
Matt (Oncall): Assign action items: Sam -> implement fast-path heuristic P0-P1 design doc. Evan -> add alert and dashboard panels for validator latency and queue length. Priya -> follow up with customer and close temporary config change once stable.
Priya (Support): Customer reports p99 dropped back to normal within 90s of the flip. They saw no functional regressions. I'll keep them posted.
Sam (Eng-runtime): For reproducibility: steps to repro locally (dev env):
1) Start router with strict_schema=true and validator stub that sleeps 50-120ms randomly.
2) Run load test: 1000 concurrent short tool-calls (max_tokens 32).
3) Measure /router/latency p99 and validator queue length.

Sam (Eng-runtime): Quick mitigation notes to include in KB: - Avoid strict sync validation on high-throughput routes. - Use async validation + schema-lite checks. - Use model-variant that skips validation for trusted tenants. - If you must use strict_schema, provision extra validator pool capacity and increase router concurrency.
Evan (Eng-platform): Config change history: we merged schema rollout last week (canary). We missed adding the validator p99 alert to the rollout checklist. Fixing that now in rollout-checklist.md.
SupportBot: Created internal ticket INC-5789 and linked this thread.
Priya (Support): Thanks team, I'll update the customer and mark the incident as mitigated for now. Will re-open if any regression. :thumbsup:
Sam (Eng-runtime): Follow-up: let's schedule a short retro tomorrow to decide default behavior for strict_schema (safe default probably off for public hosted routes).
Matt (Oncall): Noted. Closing loop: immediate customer impact resolved, next steps tracked in INC-5789 and RFC-210 for validator fast-path.
